svg.title: WOM technical reconstruction and verified repair
svg.desc: Actual matching Sunny Garden source, SAM masks, clean plate, metric depth, Tripo mesh and Gaussian object previews, Marble world, silhouette-fit overlays, source and novel camera renders, and a real before-after asset replacement verified over fifteen camera views. This is one retained run, not a global benchmark result.
svg.text: Rebuild the scene. Keep the evidence.
WOMPar reconstruction + WOMAgent repair · actual retained Sunny Garden demo outputs
Muse plans the scene; SAM separates its subjects
Reconstruct objects and the surrounding world
Masked / completed cutouts feed object models. The clean plate feeds the world model.
Shown preview; IDOL is also supported
Compose in the original camera frame
Fit position, orientation and scale to the SAM mask; use metric depth and the ground plane.
Magenta = SAM target · cyan = projected silhouette
Frozen camera poses reveal parallax and hidden surfaces.
WOMAgent: investigate → test a repair → replay → verify
A real retained replay: replace a contaminated bicycle asset, then check the same 15 camera views.
One replay: 9 sightings fixed; 32 issues remained open. Budget-limited run; no Global Par claim.
WOMetrics retains masks, poses, rendered views, tool traces, verification outcomes, cost and time.
